deniedGlobals.Date: The core is deterministic: time comes from the tick, never the wall clock.
deniedGlobals.performance: The core is deterministic: time comes from the tick, never the wall clock.
deniedGlobals.setTimeout: The core never schedules work; the clock driver outside the core does.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: The core never schedules work; the clock driver outside the core does.
deniedGlobals.process: The core receives everything it needs as arguments.
deniedGlobals.Bun: The core is runtime-agnostic and does no I/O.
deniedGlobals.crypto: Use the core's own RNG streams.
deniedGlobals.require: The core imports only from src/core/.
